#### What's Changed

- Use Go modules by [@​klauspost](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost) in [#​65](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/pgzip/pull/65)
- Handle multistream with readahead by [@​klauspost](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost) in [#​68](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/pgzip/pull/68)
- fix: return currentBuffer and prevTail to dstPool in init to stop leak by [@​SAY-5](https://redirect.github.com/SAY-5) in [#​69](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/pgzip/pull/69)
- fix: avoid deadlock on Read after WriteTo drain by [@​Solaris-star](https://redirect.github.com/Solaris-star) in [#​71](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/pgzip/pull/71)
